shiva.name: Shiva
shiva.blurb: Jyotirlingas, Panch Kedar, Pancha Bhuta Sthalams, and living Shaiva shrines across India and the Himalaya.
shiva.lede: Temples where Shiva is the primary deity — from Kedarnath and Kashi to coastal and Deccan linga kshetras.

vishnu.name: Vishnu
vishnu.blurb: Vaishnava seats of Narayana / Vishnu — Tirumala, Badrinath, Srirangam, Padmanabha, and related forms.
vishnu.lede: Temples centred on Vishnu and his classic forms (excluding Krishna-primary Braj–Dwarka pages, which have their own list).

krishna.name: Krishna
krishna.blurb: Braj, Dwarka, Vitthal, Jagannath, Guruvayur, Nathdwara, and modern ISKCON — the living Krishna trail.
krishna.lede: Temples and tirthas where Krishna (and closely related forms such as Vitthal, Shrinathji, Jagannath) is the heart of devotion.

devi.name: Devi / Shakti
devi.blurb: Shakti Peethas and great Devi temples — Kamakhya, Kalighat, Meenakshi, Vaishno Devi, and more.
devi.lede: Goddess temples across Shakta, Durga, Kali, Lakshmi, and regional Mother traditions.

ganesha.name: Ganesha
ganesha.blurb: Ashtavinayak and beloved Vinayaka shrines — Morgaon to Mumbai Siddhivinayak.
ganesha.lede: Temples of Ganesha, remover of obstacles, across Maharashtra and beyond.

rama.name: Rama
rama.blurb: Ayodhya, Bhadrachalam, Chitrakoot, and Ramayana-trail temples of Rama devotion.
rama.lede: Shrines where Rama is the primary deity or the clear focus of pilgrimage.

hanuman.name: Hanuman
hanuman.blurb: Salasar, Sankat Mochan, Jakhoo, Patna Mahavir, and other living Hanuman seats.
hanuman.lede: Temples dedicated to Hanuman — strength, devotion, and Ramayana seva.

ayyappa.name: Ayyappa
ayyappa.lede: Hill and forest pilgrimage centred on Lord Ayyappa.

sai.name: Sai Baba
sai.blurb: Shirdi Sai Baba devotion — faith (shraddha) and patience (saburi).
sai.lede: Temples and aarti dedicated to Sai Baba of Shirdi.

murugan.name: Murugan / Kartikeya
murugan.blurb: Palani, Thiruchendur, Swamimalai, Marudhamalai, and Tamil–Kannada hill Murugan kshetras.
murugan.lede: Temples of Lord Murugan (Skanda, Subramanya, Kartikeya) — vel, peacock vahana, and six-faced wisdom.

surya.name: Surya
surya.blurb: Konark, Deo, Modhera, and living solar shrines tied to Chhath and dawn arghya.
surya.lede: Sun temples and Surya-narayana seats where dawn worship marks time and health.

shani.name: Shani
shani.blurb: Shani Shingnapur, Shani temples, and Saturday graha-shanti pilgrimage.
shani.lede: Shrines of Shani Dev — justice, patience, and Saturday oil-lamp devotion.

dattatreya.name: Dattatreya
dattatreya.blurb: Ganagapur, Narsobawadi, and avadhuta–guru seats of the trimurti ascetic.
dattatreya.lede: Temples remembering Dattatreya as the wandering guru of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva.

narasimha.name: Narasimha
narasimha.blurb: Ahobilam, Simhachalam, Yadagirigutta, and man-lion avatara kshetras.
narasimha.lede: Narasimha temples where Vishnu appeared as the man-lion at twilight.

vitthal.name: Vitthal / Vithoba
vitthal.blurb: Pandharpur Wari, Dehu, and Maharashtra–Karnataka Varkari Vitthal seats.
vitthal.lede: Vitthal temples of the Varkari path — standing Krishna with hands on hips.

bhairav.name: Bhairav
bhairav.blurb: Kal Bhairav of Ujjain, Kashi, and fierce Shiva guardian shrines.
bhairav.lede: Bhairav temples — Shiva’s terrifying form guarding tirthas and cremation grounds.

lakshmi.name: Lakshmi
lakshmi.blurb: Kolhapur Mahalaxmi, Ashtalakshmi, and prosperity Goddess pilgrimage.
lakshmi.lede: Temples where Lakshmi is the primary or co-primary deity of darshan.

saraswati.name: Saraswati
saraswati.blurb: Basar, Pushkar Saraswati, and learning-Goddess aksharabhyasam seats.
saraswati.lede: Saraswati temples for education vows, Vasant Panchami, and first letters.

kali.name: Kali
kali.blurb: Kalighat, Dakshineswar, Kamakhya-adjacent Kali devotion, and Bengal Shakta seats.
kali.lede: Kali temples of the dark Goddess — tongue, sword, and fierce compassion.

jagannath.name: Jagannath
jagannath.blurb: Puri Rath Yatra, Ranchi, Agartala, and Odia–Bengali Jagannath culture.
jagannath.lede: Jagannath temples with wooden deities, mahaprasad, and annual chariot festivals.

venkateswara.name: Venkateswara / Balaji
venkateswara.blurb: Tirumala, Chilkur, and Balaji pilgrimage across South and diaspora search.
venkateswara.lede: Venkateswara temples — hill darshan, hundi vows, and Balaji grace.

annapurna.name: Annapurna
annapurna.blurb: Kashi Annapurna, Horanadu, Indore, and food-Goddess annadanam seats.
annapurna.lede: Annapurna temples where the Goddess feeds the world and devotees.

santoshi.name: Santoshi Mata
santoshi.blurb: Friday vrata culture and modern Mother-Goddess temples across North India.
santoshi.lede: Santoshi Mata shrines — contentment, Friday fast, and household vows.
